question: The area of a square inscribed in a circle, whose diagonal is 16 cm, is:
solution:
Given:

Diagonal of the square = 16 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5eaa5bcb74589a6385a25742782b834766634c503387b9ed0c0b00d5e5a4793.png] 

Concept used:

Diagonal of a square = a√2

Area of a square = a²

Where, a is the length of each side of the square.

Calculation:

Side of the square = 16 ÷ √2 = 8√2

Area of the square = (8√2)² = 128 cm²

**∴ The area of a square inscribed in a circle, whose diagonal is 16 cm, is 128 cm2.**
